语阅隐私说明Yuyue Privacy Policy

生效日期：2026 年 11 月 27 日 Effective: November 27, 2026

一句话 数据存在哪 什么时候联网 Key 和密码 在设备上完成的 保存和删除 联系

一句话

语阅是一款免费的本地读书与听书软件，没有注册登录、广告或跨应用追踪，也不向任何内容服务器上传你的书库。为了解功能使用情况，应用默认开启仅记录功能使用形态的匿名统计（不关联个人身份，绝不收集书名、笔记、划线或搜索词），可随时在「关于」页一键关闭。

数据存在哪

书、进度、划线、想法、生词、播客和设置都存在你自己的设备上。打开同步时，它们只在你的设备和你自己选的网盘（iCloud 云盘或 WebDAV，Google Drive 即将支持）之间传，开发者收不到，也看不到。

什么时候联网

只在你自己设置或主动触发下面这些的时候：

  • 同步：连你选的网盘。
  • 远程书库与播客订阅：直接连你添加的 OPDS / WebDAV 书库，或拉取你订阅的播客 RSS 与单集音频。
  • 书伴与书房电台：填了自己的云端 Key 时，你的提问、相关摘录与原文片段直接发给你选的服务商；没填云端 Key 时使用设备端侧模型或你自己的本机 / 局域网模型。
  • 在线与云端声音：使用内置免费在线声音时，当前要读的句子会直接发给对应在线语音服务（无需 Key）；自行配置云端声音（OpenAI、微软 Azure、ElevenLabs、火山引擎、阿里云百炼、硅基流动、MiniMax、Fish Audio、Deepgram、小米 MiMo 等）并填了 Key 时，要读的句子直接发给你选的服务商。读过的声音存在你的设备上。
  • 克隆声音：本机克隆全程在设备上完成、不上传录音；仅在你主动接上自己的 ElevenLabs 账号克隆时，那段录音才会传到你自己的账号。
  • 笔记导出：填了 Notion、flomo 或新枝的令牌或链接时，你发出去的划线直接发给那个服务。
  • 按需模型、声音包与字体：用到有声书对齐、本机离线语音或下载字体时，会从 GitHub Releases、魔搭（ModelScope）或 Hugging Face 下载对齐模型、离线语音模型、内置声音包和开源字体（字体预览样字按需从 Google Fonts 加载）；运行全在你的设备上完成，原文与录音不出本机。
  • 应用内反馈（仅在你主动提交时）：通过 AirFeedback 单通道直发给开发者，正文、可选的去 EXIF 截图与可选的基础设备/版本信息仅开发者可见、不会公开，也不收集邮箱或联系方式。Apple 端同时支持基于系统 MetricKit 的崩溃诊断上报以协助定位闪退。
  • 匿名使用统计（可在「关于」页随时关闭）：仅记录功能使用形态（如页面与功能开关的枚举值），不建立个人档案、不关联身份，绝不收集书名、作者、文件名、笔记、划线、搜索词或网址。
  • 检查更新（直接下载安装的版本，默认开，可在设置里关掉）：定期从国内镜像或 GitHub Releases 获取更新元数据（Mac、Windows、Android 均支持），不携带任何关于你和书库的信息。应用商店版本不自查，由商店更新。

第三方

语阅不包含任何广告或跨应用追踪代码。除上述可随时关闭的匿名功能形态统计与你主动提交的私密反馈外，其余所有网络请求都从你的设备直接发给你自己选定的服务商，适用它们自己的隐私条款。

Key 和密码

你填的 Key、令牌和密码只存在设备上，不同步、不上传。iPhone 和 iPad 存在系统钥匙串里，Android 存在由系统密钥库加密的存储里，Windows 使用 DPAPI（当前用户范围）加密保存在本机，Mac 存在 App 沙盒文件夹里的本机权限文件中，只有当前系统账号可读。

在设备上完成的

有声书对齐、播客本地转写与语音插话提问时的语音转文字，以及翻译、本机和系统声音朗读、查词，都在你的设备上完成。

保存和删除

开发者手里没有你的任何数据，所以不需要向我们申请删除。在 App 里删掉书或笔记，就从设备上删掉了；删掉 App，它在这台设备上存的东西会全部删除；你自己网盘里的同步文件会一直留着，直到你自己删。

改主意

在设置里关掉同步、移除远程书库或播客订阅，或删掉 Key、令牌，语阅就立刻不再连那个服务。

儿童

语阅不收集任何人的个人身份信息或阅读内容，包括儿童。

联系

有问题请写信：yuyue.app@icloud.com

In short Where data lives Network access Keys & passwords On-device Deleting data Contact

In short

Yuyue (语阅) is a free local reading and listening app with no accounts, no ads, no cross-app tracking, and no content servers of its own. To understand how features are used, the app includes optional anonymous usage-shape analytics (never linked to identity; never collecting book titles, notes, highlights, or search queries), which you can turn off anytime in About.

Where your data lives

Your books, reading progress, highlights, notes, word lists, podcasts and settings are stored on your own device. If you turn on sync, they travel only between your devices and the storage you choose yourself — iCloud Drive or a WebDAV server (Google Drive coming soon). The developer never receives or sees them.

When the app goes online

Only for things you set up or trigger yourself:

  • Sync with the storage you chose.
  • Remote libraries (OPDS or WebDAV) and podcast feeds (RSS or episode links) you added, fetched straight from their publishers.
  • The reading companion and studio radio with your own API key: your question or reading notes and related passages go directly to the AI provider you picked. Without a cloud key, they use an on-device or local LAN model.
  • Online & cloud voices: when you use the built-in free online voice, the sentence being read is sent directly to the online speech service without an API key; when you configure a cloud voice provider with your own key (such as OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, ElevenLabs, Volcengine, DashScope, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, Fish Audio, Deepgram, or Xiaomi MiMo), sentences go directly to the provider you picked. Audio already received is kept on your device.
  • Voice cloning with your own ElevenLabs account: the short recording of you reading is kept on your device and sent to that account only when you explicitly clone a voice there; on-device voice cloning never uploads audio.
  • Note export to Notion, flomo or Xinzhi (新枝) with your own token or webhook: the highlights you send go directly to that service.
  • On-demand models, voice packs and fonts: alignment models, offline voice models, the built-in voice pack and optional open-source fonts are downloaded from GitHub Releases, ModelScope, or Hugging Face when you use those features (font preview samples load from Google Fonts on demand). They run locally on your device; your books and recordings never leave the device.
  • In-app feedback (only when you choose to send it): sent privately to the developer over AirFeedback; your message, optional EXIF-stripped screenshots, and optional basic device/app info are never made public and no email address is collected. Apple builds also support system MetricKit crash diagnostics to help fix crashes.
  • Anonymous usage analytics (optional; switch off anytime in About): records closed-enum usage shapes only—never creates person profiles, never links to your identity, and never transmits book titles, authors, filenames, notes, highlights, search queries, or URLs.
  • Update checks (direct-download builds for Mac, Windows, and Android; on by default, switchable in Settings): periodically fetches release metadata from the China mirror or GitHub Releases without sending personal or library data. App Store and Google Play builds leave updates to the store.

Third parties

Yuyue contains no advertising or cross-app tracking code. Aside from the opt-out anonymous usage-shape analytics and private feedback you choose to submit, every other network request goes straight from your device to the provider you picked, under their own privacy terms.

Keys and passwords

Keys, tokens and passwords you enter stay on your device and are never synced or uploaded. On iPhone and iPad they are kept in the Keychain, on Android in a store encrypted by the system Keystore, on Windows encrypted locally with Windows DPAPI (CurrentUser scope), and on Mac in a local file inside the app’s sandbox folder readable only by your user account.

On-device features

Speech recognition (for audiobook alignment, local podcast transcription and spoken podcast Q&A), translation, read-aloud with local and system voices and the dictionary all run on your device.

Keeping and deleting your data

Because the developer holds none of your data, there is nothing to request from us. Deleting a book or note in the app removes it from your device. Deleting the app removes everything it stored on that device; files in your own sync storage stay there until you delete them.

Changing your mind

Turn off sync, remove a remote library or podcast feed, or delete a key or token in the app's settings, and Yuyue stops contacting that service right away.

Children

Yuyue collects no personal information or reading content from anyone, including children.

Contact

Questions: yuyue.app@icloud.com
